Allowed origins today: `http://localhost:4200`, any `*.pages.dev`, any `*.workers.dev`.

**File:** `worker/src/index.ts`
**Where:** inside the `origin` callback passed to `cors({...})` (the `app.use('*', cors({...}))` block, lines ~20–30).

To add a new custom domain, add another condition to that `if` check, e.g.:
```ts
origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com' ||
```
(or `origin.endsWith('.your-domain.com')` for subdomains) inside the same function — array-based origin matching won't support wildcards per the existing comment/doc note (`worker/src/index.md`, `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4).
